annotations.title: Audit a site for AI visibility

description: The AI visibility audit: the identity files, crawler policy, schema graph and page health, then the answer engines asked whether they name the site, scored out of 100. Starts a run and returns its run_id; it takes about a minute, so call get_analysis with that id. Without an account it runs the survey (the audit without its two paid steps), two a day per address; a free account gets the teaser, a paid plan the whole audit, on the account's own allowance.
